query: Design observability for a checkout service with a synchronous API and an asynchronous receipt worker. We have no agreed latency target or customer error budget yet.
expected_behavior: Separates API request RED signals from worker queue or job health and traces the handoff with a shared correlation identifier
Proposes candidate SLIs and explicitly labels any SLO target as needing owner agreement rather than inventing a contractual target
Uses low-cardinality metrics and puts request or user identifiers in logs or traces with privacy controls
Makes alerts symptom-based and actionable with an owner and response
